referenceFunction.includedProcesses: 1 meter of noise barrier wall installed along the roadside in open terrain. Total visible height: 3.2 meters, consisting of a ribbed concrete panel with a height of 3.0 meters. Service life 80 years. The system boundary includes production (A1–A3) and construction / transport (A4–A5) stages for one meter of installed noise barrier wall, including excavation, backfilling, and foundation works.
